articles.title: 5 European nations follow U.S. with plans for third-country deportations as EU approves migrant "return hubs" - CBS News
articles.description: Five European countries are moving ahead with plans to send rejected asylum applicants to "return hubs" in countries outside the bloc under new EU rules.
